title: Govind Saran Ganga Saran v. Commissioner of Sales Tax

content.caseIdentity: Govind Saran Ganga Saran v. Commissioner of Sales Tax, 155 ITR 144 (SC)
content.facts: The Court examined the components of a valid charging provision.
questionsBeforeCourt: What must a tax levy clearly identify to be valid?
content.ratioDecidendi: A valid levy ordinarily identifies the taxable event, person liable, rate and measure or value of the tax.
content.holding: The Court treated these components as essential to a charging scheme.
content.relevance: Use for charge, levy and statutory certainty.

evidence.note: Supreme Court of India 1985 Supp SCC 205; 155 ITR 144; 1985 INSC 103; 1985 (3) SCR 985; four essential components of tax liability.
